properties.name: A relation into another design is recorded as a typed reference, read back by search and the ripple, and checked against the far design
properties.rationale: Anthony's pick (b), 2026-10-07: a typed link kept in the design that makes it, checked for a far end that moved. It is the shared piece the duplicate warning, slice 3, the ripple and the root-cause neighbours pass need. A Resource was chosen over a stand-in of the far type because no detector skips imported nodes. The fingerprint check reuses the pin's watch, so a hosted design, which cannot watch another, reports a link it cannot check rather than passing it.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Item 4 of the one-graph build order. A relation link takes other_design and other_name; the design keeps a reference (xref:<design>:<node>) and draws the relation to it. upstream_status lists references and reports links into undeclared designs and links whose far design moved; loop_status names them; search's linked and the ripple name the far design.
